about: Written by hand, never generated (ORCH-752, ORCH-756): each tool's one line, saying what it does and when to use it, as a worker's or a checker's run lists every tool outside its full core (tools.find gives the full description). Exactly one line for each tool of engine/fixtures/catalog/tools.json and catalog_additions.json (the catalog test checks it). Model-facing: short, 'What it does. Use when ...'.

lines.actions.search: Search FERB's installed actions by what they do. Use before saying FERB can't do something.
lines.tools.find: Give the full description and arguments of tools listed by one line. Use before calling one of them when you're unsure of its arguments.
lines.abilities.list: List FERB's packaged abilities, such as the browser verification procedure. Use when a task may have a ready procedure.
lines.abilities.read: Read one packaged ability's procedure. Use after abilities.list names one that fits, such as a bot check.
lines.device.facts: Read this Mac's facts now: time, place, battery, network, displays, disk, sleep. Use when the task depends on the Mac's state or the owner's phones.
lines.fs.list: List a folder's files with their paths, sizes and dates. Use to find files or see what a folder holds.
lines.fs.read: Read a text file, or part of one. Use to read a file's contents.
lines.fs.look: See a picture or a PDF page on disk as an image. Use for a photo, screenshot, scan or a file the owner attached.
lines.fs.disk_usage: Count the files and bytes under a path from metadata only. Use when the owner asks how much space something takes.
lines.fs.write: Create or overwrite a text file. Use to save text the task produced.
lines.fs.edit: Replace one exact piece of text in a text file. Use to change part of a file and keep the rest as it is.
lines.fs.trash: Move a file or folder to the Trash, recoverably. Use when the owner wants something deleted.
lines.fs.copy: Copy one file to a new path. Use when the owner wants a copy of a file somewhere.
lines.fs.move: Move or rename a file or folder on the same disk. Use to rename or reorganize files.
lines.owner.ask: Ask the owner a needed choice or missing detail. Use only when the context can't answer it; never for passwords or codes.
lines.recording.stop: Stop and save a recording this task started. Use when the part to record is over.
lines.recording.inspect: Turn a saved video into a sheet of labelled frames. Use to check what a recording really shows.
lines.recovery.snapshot: Take a disk snapshot as a recovery point. Use before bulk or destructive file work.
lines.browser.open: Open a new background tab in the owner's browser profile. Use to visit a web page.
lines.browser.navigate: Load another address in one of this task's tabs. Use to go to a new page in a tab you have.
lines.browser.snapshot: Read a tab's text and its elements with ids to act on. Use to see a page before and after acting.
lines.browser.read: Page through the whole last snapshot. Use when a snapshot was cut short.
lines.browser.html: Read a page's real markup. Use when an element or attribute you need isn't in the snapshot.
lines.browser.dialog: Read and answer a page's pending JavaScript dialog. Use when an alert or confirm blocks a tab.
lines.browser.profiles: List the owner's browser profiles with their accounts. Use to choose which profile a task works in.
lines.browser.pair: Pair one of the owner's browser profiles with FERB. Use when a browser tool says the profile isn't paired.
lines.browser.handoff: Hand a human check on a page to the owner and wait until it's gone. Use when a bot check still blocks after the verification procedure.
lines.browser.screenshot: See a tab as an image. Use when the snapshot misses something visible on the page.
lines.browser.pdf: Save a page, or an HTML file you wrote, as a PDF. Use when the owner wants a PDF file.
lines.browser.point: Find which element sits at a point of a recent tab screenshot. Use before acting on something only the screenshot shows.
lines.browser.act: Click, type, paste, select, press keys or drag on an element of the latest snapshot. Use to do anything on a web page.
lines.browser.wait: Wait up to 30 seconds for a tab to load or show some text. Use after an action that loads a page.
lines.browser.close: Close a tab this task opened, or let go of a borrowed one. Use when the task is done with a tab.
lines.browser.keep_open: Keep a tab open after the task ends. Use when the owner wants a page left running, such as a class or a video.
lines.browser.scroll: Scroll a page or a scrolling list by screens. Use to reach or load more of a feed, list or long page.
lines.browser.find: Search a whole page for text and get the matching elements' ids. Use to find a button, link or line without reading everything.
lines.browser.downloads: List the files this task's tabs downloaded and where FERB kept them. Use after a click that starts a download.
lines.browser.media: Play, pause, mute or seek a video or audio on a page. Use when the task needs media playing or stopped.
lines.browser.tabs: List the tabs the owner has open. Use when he refers to a tab he already has open.
lines.browser.use_tab: Take over one of the owner's open tabs for this task. Use after browser.tabs finds the tab he means.
lines.browser.login_code: Ask the owner for a login code and fill it without you seeing it. Use on the login he asked for, once the code field shows.
lines.browser.secret: Fill a password, code or card detail into a page's field from the owner's hidden input or a saved secret. Use for any secret on a web page; never type one.
lines.browser.record: Record a video of a tab, with its sound when asked. Use when the owner wants a recording of a page.
lines.mac.apps: List the apps running on the Mac. Use to see what is open before working in an app.
lines.mac.open: Open an installed app, or a file or address in it, in the background. Use when the task needs an app that isn't running.
lines.mac.snapshot: Read an app's window: its text and controls with ids to act on. Use to see a Mac app before and after acting.
lines.mac.menu: List or press an app's menu bar items. Use when a command lives only in the app's menus.
lines.mac.act: Press, type, set a value or scroll on a control of a Mac app's snapshot. Use to do things in a Mac app.
lines.mac.secret: Fill a password or code into a Mac app's field from the owner's hidden input or a saved secret. Use for any secret in a Mac app.
lines.mac.applescript: Run AppleScript inside one scriptable Mac app. Use when the app does it more reliably by script than by clicking; never for shell commands or web pages.
lines.mac.screenshot: See one app window as an image. Use when its snapshot doesn't show enough.
lines.mac.click: Click a pixel of a recent app screenshot. Use when the control isn't in the snapshot.
lines.mac.pointer: Click, drag, hover or scroll at a recent screenshot's pixels in a Mac app. Use for a pointer gesture the snapshot's controls can't do.
lines.mac.record: Record a video of one app window, with its sound when asked. Use when the owner wants a recording of an app.
lines.mac.clipboard: Put text on the Mac's clipboard. Use when the owner wants something copied to paste himself.
lines.audio.listen: Hear what an app or a tab is playing and get a timed transcript. Use when the task needs what a video, call or song says.
lines.shell.run: Run a shell command and wait for it. Use for command-line work: files, git, scripts, searches with mdfind.
lines.shell.start: Start a long shell command and get its id at once. Use for builds, downloads or servers that take a while.
lines.shell.wait: Wait up to 120 seconds for a command to finish. Use for a command that ends soon; wait.for for a longer one.
lines.shell.read: Read a command's output from an offset. Use to follow a running command's progress.
lines.shell.send: Send text to a running command's input. Use when a command asks a question.
lines.shell.kill: Stop one of this task's commands. Use when a command hangs or is no longer needed.
lines.shell.list: List this task's commands and their state. Use to find a command's id.
lines.shell.rules: List what FERB's sandbox keeps the shell out of. Use when the sandbox refuses a command.
lines.project.publish: Push a project's git branch with the owner's own git login. Use when the owner wants commits published.
lines.project.fetch: Fetch or clone a git repository with the owner's own git login. Use for a private repository commands can't reach.
lines.trail.query: Read the owner's recent activity on the Mac: apps, pages, files. Use when the task depends on what he did.
lines.trail.days: Read the owner's daily activity summaries. Use for what he did on an earlier day.
lines.task.evidence: Read this task's recorded calls, results and context. Use to check what was really done before you answer.
lines.time.remind_at: Set a reminder at a time the owner named. Use only when he asked to be reminded.
lines.time.set_timer: Set a timer for the owner. Use only when he asked for a timer.
lines.time.sleep_until: Pause this task until a time. Use when something will only be ready later.
lines.wait.for: Wait in code until a process, file, page or script condition holds. Use instead of checking again and again.
lines.skills.read: Read an owner-written skill or one of its files. Use when one of his skills fits the task.
lines.chat.history: Read this conversation's earlier messages and tasks. Use when the task needs something said or done earlier.
lines.task.trace: Read one task's trace: its steps, checks, calls and errors. Use for what a task did or why it stopped.
lines.chat.ask: Ask the owner one short question about what, who or which. Use when his request is missing that.
lines.chat.control_task: Stop, pause, continue, correct or retry a task, or answer its question. Use when the owner says so about a task.
lines.chat.dispatch_task: Start a task on the Mac, the web or in an app. Use when the owner asks FERB to do something.
lines.chat.remember: Remember or forget something the owner said. Use when he asks FERB to remember or forget.
lines.chat.schedule: Create, change, cancel or show schedules. Use when the owner asks for something on a schedule.
lines.chat.set_reminder: Set or cancel reminders and timers. Use when the owner asks for a reminder or a timer.
lines.memory.read: Read what FERB remembers about the owner, with where each item came from. Use before stating a fact about him or his preferences.
lines.memory.import: Bring a chat export or coding sessions into FERB's memory. Use only when the owner asks FERB to learn from them.
lines.secrets.list: List what is saved for a login: the username and the names of its sealed entries. Use on a login page before asking the owner.
lines.about.read: Read FERB's own description, settings and how-tos. Use when the task is about FERB itself.
lines.about.diagnostics: Read FERB's own recent diagnostics: connections, permissions, its log. Use when something of FERB's own didn't work.
lines.conversation.read: Read the conversation FERB holds for the owner in this task. Use to see its turns and outcomes.
lines.memory.learned: Find past tasks, playbooks and how they were done. Use before a task FERB may have done before.
lines.ferb_browser.open: Open a new background tab in FERB's own browser. Use to visit a web page with FERB's own account.
lines.ferb_browser.navigate: Load another address in one of this task's tabs in FERB's browser. Use to go to a new page in a tab you have.
lines.ferb_browser.snapshot: Read a tab of FERB's browser: its text and elements with ids. Use to see a page before and after acting.
lines.ferb_browser.read: Page through the whole last snapshot in FERB's browser. Use when a snapshot was cut short.
lines.ferb_browser.html: Read a page's real markup in FERB's browser. Use when an element or attribute you need isn't in the snapshot.
lines.ferb_browser.dialog: Read and answer a page's pending dialog in FERB's browser. Use when an alert or confirm blocks a tab.
lines.ferb_browser.screenshot: See a tab of FERB's browser as an image. Use when the snapshot misses something visible.
lines.ferb_browser.pdf: Save a page of FERB's browser, or an HTML file you wrote, as a PDF. Use when the owner wants a PDF file.
lines.ferb_browser.point: Find which element sits at a point of a recent screenshot in FERB's browser. Use before acting on something only the screenshot shows.
lines.ferb_browser.act: Click, type, paste, select or press keys on an element in FERB's browser. Use to do anything on a web page there.
lines.ferb_browser.wait: Wait up to 30 seconds for a tab of FERB's browser to load or show some text. Use after an action that loads a page.
lines.ferb_browser.close: Close a tab this task opened in FERB's browser. Use when the task is done with it.
lines.ferb_browser.keep_open: Keep a tab of FERB's browser open after the task ends. Use when the owner wants a page left running.
lines.ferb_browser.scroll: Scroll a page or a scrolling list in FERB's browser by screens. Use to reach or load more of a feed, list or long page.
lines.ferb_browser.find: Search a whole page in FERB's browser for text and get the matching elements' ids. Use to find a button, link or line quickly.
lines.ferb_browser.downloads: List the files this task's tabs in FERB's browser downloaded and where FERB kept them. Use after a click that starts a download.
lines.ferb_browser.media: Play, pause, mute or seek a video or audio on a page in FERB's browser. Use when the task needs media playing or stopped.
lines.ferb_browser.fill_secret: Fill one of FERB's own saved passwords into a field. Use to sign in with FERB's own account.
lines.ferb_browser.fill_otp: Fill a code from FERB's inbox into its field without you seeing it. Use after ferb_browser.otp_candidates names the right one.
lines.ferb_browser.otp_candidates: List the codes waiting in FERB's inbox, without their digits. Use when a sign-in sends FERB a code.
lines.ferb_browser.record: Record a video of a tab in FERB's browser. Use when the owner wants a recording of a page.
